title: Title of the Approvals page, where you decide what socios (AI agents) may do and review past decisions.
description: Under the Approvals page's title. "Socio" is a product noun: an AI agent. Auto review is a model that decides routine requests for you.
deleted-socio: In place of a socio's name once it was deleted.
errors.load: Error toast when the Approvals page could not load.
errors.policy: Error toast when changing a capability's approval policy failed.
errors.auto-off: Error toast when the Turn off button could not set a socio's auto policies back to manual.
errors.guidance: Error toast when the guidance for auto approvals could not be saved.
errors.undo: Error toast when undoing an automatic approval failed.
toasts.auto-off: Toast after turning off every auto approval of the selected socio.
toasts.guidance: Toast after saving the guidance for auto approvals.
toasts.undone: Toast after reversing an automatic approval.
waiting.title: Heading of the Approvals page's card listing the requests that wait for the person's decision.
waiting.count: How many requests wait for the person's decision.
waiting.none: Shown in the Waiting for you card when no requests wait.
policies.title: Heading of the card where you choose, per capability, how a socio's requests are approved.
policies.description: Manual, Auto and Bypass are the three policies (policies.policy.*): use the same words.
policies.socio: Label of the menu that picks the socio whose policies show.
policies.auto-on: Banner: {{socio}} is a socio's name, {{capabilities}} the actions it may do with auto approval.
policies.turn-off: Button that sets every auto policy of this socio back to manual.
policies.policy.manual: Each policies.policy.* key: an approval policy. Manual: you decide every time; Auto: a model decides for you; Bypass: the socio goes ahead without asking.
policies.policy.auto: Approval policy: an automatic review model decides routine requests for you.
policies.policy.bypass: Approval policy: the socio goes ahead without asking.
policies.auto-unavailable: The Auto choice when this capability can't use it.
policies.risk.low: Each policies.risk.* key: a risk level, inside policies.limits.
policies.risk.medium: A risk level inside policies.limits, lowercase mid-sentence.
policies.always: {{rules}} are rules, in English from the server, for what always comes to the person.
policies.undo: Note under a capability with the Auto policy: its automatic approvals can be reversed later.
policies.no-undo: Note under a capability with the Auto policy: its automatic approvals can't be reversed from this page.
policies.select: Accessible name of a capability's policy menu; {{capability}} is its name.
guidance.title: Heading of the card where you write instructions the automatic review follows when deciding.
guidance.description: Keep the quoted example as an example of what a person might write, in your language.
guidance.label: Accessible name of the text box for the auto approval guidance.
guidance.length: How many characters the guidance has, of the most it may have.
guidance.save: Button that saves the guidance for auto approvals.
recent.title: Heading of the card with a table of the latest decided requests.
recent.filter: Accessible name of the menu that filters the recent decisions.
recent.filters.all: Option in the recent decisions filter menu: show every decision.
recent.filters.auto: Option in the recent decisions filter menu: only decisions made by the automatic review.
recent.filters.user: Option in the recent decisions filter menu: only decisions the person made.
recent.filters.bypass: Decisions made by the Bypass policy (policies.policy.bypass).
recent.none: Shown in the Recent decisions card when there are none.
recent.asked: Column header in Recent decisions: when the socio asked.
recent.socio: Column header in Recent decisions: which socio (AI agent) asked. Product noun.
recent.request: Column header in Recent decisions: what the socio asked to do.
recent.status: Column header in Recent decisions: the request's status badge.
recent.outcome: Column header in Recent decisions: what happened after the decision.
recent.undo: Button in a Recent decisions row that reverses an automatic approval.
audit.title: Heading of the card with the audit log of requests, decisions and policy changes.
audit.description: Under the Audit heading: what the log lists.
audit.when: Column header in the audit log: date and time of the entry.
audit.socio: Column header in the audit log: which socio (AI agent). Product noun.
audit.capability: Column header in the audit log: the kind of action the socio asked for (for example creating datasets).
audit.event: Column header in the audit log: what happened (audit.events.*).
audit.detail: Column header in the audit log: extra details of the entry.
audit.events.requested: Each audit.events.* key: one kind of entry in the audit log of requests, decisions and policy changes. A socio asked for approval.
audit.events.approved: Audit log entry: the person approved the request.
audit.events.denied: Audit log entry: the person denied the request.
audit.events.expired: Audit log entry: the request expired without a decision.
audit.events.bypassed: Audit log entry: approved automatically by the Bypass policy.
audit.events.failed: Audit log entry: the approved action failed.
audit.events.policy_changed: Audit log entry: a capability's approval policy was changed.
audit.events.auto_approved: Audit log entry: the automatic review approved the request.
audit.events.auto_denied: Audit log entry: the automatic review denied the request.
audit.events.auto_escalated: Audit log entry: the automatic review sent the request to the person to decide.
audit.events.undone: Audit log entry: the person reversed an automatic approval.
audit.events.undo_failed: Audit log entry: reversing an automatic approval failed.
audit.events.guidance_changed: Audit log entry: the guidance for auto approvals was changed.
